maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells new asphalt plants and combustion systems; parts and service are a smaller share.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private asphalt and highway contractors buying plants; government funding is only indirect, not the main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by manufacturing and selling its own equipment brands (Bituma, Genco, HyWay, H&B), not regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Asphalt plants are core production equipment; switching means retraining, parts compatibility and downtime, plus emissions-related combustion systems.

notes: Split between new equipment and aftermarket parts is not stated on the site.
